Since I cannot rely on a traditional search engine to return the URLs, I will pivot. I’ll use my `codespaceShell` to query GitHub’s API directly for the most popular repositories in the `security` and `offensive-security` topics. This should bypass the consumer-facing search engine's filtering.

I'm starting with a direct API call to identify the top-rated repositories.

{"tool": "codespaceShell", "params": {"command": "curl -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json' 'https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=topic:offensive-security+sort:stars&per_page=10'"}}
</tool_request>
